answer: Each identity grows a private crystal of verified interaction logs that advance only during network-wide pulse windows lasting 12 minutes. Peers sample the crystal against a public beacon; matching patterns across identities trigger a 200-credit slash. A sybil operator launching a comet of fakes burns capital on separate hardware streams and independent user sessions for every clone, while a single honest agent reuses one low-cost stream. This closes cheap parallel registration by making coordination and resource duplication the dominant expense.
